description: Gryphon playground — the muck-around flavor. A shippable, in-package boot RECORD (rides the gryphon_playground wheel/git artifact at tap_plugin/gryphon_playground/boot/, per req-boot-bootstrap-records-in-package) that stands up the closest-to-minimal TAP instance: just the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary and the gryphon_playground Gridkin corpus/harness that depends_on it, existing only to exercise the Gryphon query language and nothing else. No admin chrome, no seeded data, no collectors: the grid comes up empty and reaches out to nothing, and the Gridkin corpus builds its scenarios at query/test time rather than seeding population (hence an empty population section). The web UI and API surfaces still mount (auth/login is the only web chrome), because a truly headless boot is not yet supported (backlog: tap_web req-web-rendering-headless; tap_api headless-API disable). Install sources are GIT (the shippable-record class travels to deployments and pulls its plugins from their own repos via the github-plugins-ro PAT); a repo-local editable harness profile serves monorepo dev. Selected by pointer `<source-ref>#playground`.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.grid_fixtures). Install-only: the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the Gridkin corpus references by string. Migrated so the corpus has real types to query. No GRIFT seed, no cross-plugin deps. Listed before gryphon_playground, which depends_on it. Pulled at boot from its own repo via authed git source (PAT through GIT_ASKPASS, never in the URL); rev pinned to the immutable tag v0.1.0.

Self-reference (app-of-apps, req-boot-bootstrap-stage0-3): the record shipped inside gryphon_playground@v0.1.0 names gryphon_playground@v0.1.0 in its own install set, so stage-0's fetch-without-import peek is followed by a proper pinned install. The Gridkin scenario corpus + harness that exercise the Gryphon query language; owns NO node/edge types of its own (references grid_fixtures__* by string → depends_on grid_fixtures, installed above). Carries NO GRIFT population seed.
